jobs.title: SAP Business Analyst (Functional)
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**  
The SAP Business Analyst is the lead for the SAP landscape in Singapore. The role works directly with users across finance, supply chain, sales operations and customer service to understand how they work today, where the system gets in their way, and what needs to change. It converts that understanding into clear SAP requirements, process designs and change requests that the configuration, development and support teams can act on.
  
  
This is a hands-on role rather than a purely supervisory one. The manager spends time with users in the business, runs workshops, writes the specifications, tests the outcome and sees changes through to adoption. They are the main point of contact between the user community and the wider IT organisation for anything SAP-related, and are accountable for the quality of analysis, documentation and user support in their area.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Working with Business Users
  
  
Act as the primary contact for business users on SAP process and system questions, building relationships that make people comfortable raising problems early.
  
  
Run requirement workshops, process walkthroughs and interviews to understand how work is actually performed, including the workarounds people have built outside the system.
  
  
Challenge requests constructively, separating what the business genuinely needs from what it has simply always done, and agree a scope that can be delivered.
  
  
Keep users informed on the status of their requests, explaining decisions, timelines and trade-offs in plain business language.
  
  
Deliver user training, floor-walking and refresher sessions, and produce user guides and quick reference material that people will actually use.
  
  
SAP Process and Functional Analysis
  
  
Analyse end-to-end SAP processes across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, record-to-report and inventory management, identifying inefficiencies, control gaps and manual effort that can be removed.
  
  
Perform fit-gap analysis on new requirements, recommending standard SAP capability ahead of custom development wherever the business outcome allows.
  
  
Produce functional specifications, process maps, configuration change requests and user stories that are unambiguous to both business users and technical teams.
  
  
Assess the downstream impact of proposed changes across integrated modules and interfaces before design is signed off.
  
  
Work with functional consultants, developers and solution architects to validate that what is built matches what was specified.
  
  
Project and Change Delivery
  
  
Lead the business analysis workstream on SAP projects, enhancements and rollouts, from scoping through design, build, testing, cutover and post-go-live support.
  
  
Design and coordinate user acceptance testing, including test scenarios, data preparation, defect triage and business sign-off.
  
  
Support data migration and cleansing activity by defining mapping rules, validation checks and reconciliation criteria with the business.
  
  
Manage the SAP demand and change backlog, prioritising work against business value, effort and risk, and reporting progress to IT and business leadership.
  
  
Plan business readiness for each release, covering process documentation, training, communications and hypercare arrangements.
  
  
Support, Governance and Team
  
  
Provide second-line functional support on escalated SAP incidents, investigating root cause and distinguishing genuine system defects from process or training gaps.
  
  
Ensure changes follow change control, segregation of duties and audit requirements, and that process and configuration documentation is kept current.
  
  
Manage day-to-day working relationships with implementation partners and managed service providers, holding them to agreed scope, quality and timelines.
  
  
Guide and develop analysts and key users, setting analysis standards and templates so that documentation is consistent and reusable across projects.
  
  
Skills and Experience
  
  
SAP Skills
  
  
Hands-on experience with SAP ERP in a functional or process analysis capacity, with strong working knowledge of at least two core process areas such as SD, MM, FI or WM.
  
  
Understanding of SAP master data structures, organisational design and the configuration levers available within standard functionality.
  
  
Ability to read and interpret SAP transactions, standard reports and error messages well enough to investigate an issue before escalating it.
  
  
Experience of SAP project delivery through a full lifecycle, including testing, cutover and post-go-live support.
  
  
Exposure to SAP S/4HANA and to integration with surrounding systems, such as EDI, warehouse, e-commerce or reporting platforms, is an advantage.
  
  
Business Analysis Skills
  
  
Structured requirement elicitation and documentation, including process mapping, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Fit-gap and impact analysis, with sound judgement on when to configure, when to build and when to change the process instead.
  
  
Test design and coordination, including UAT planning, defect management and readiness assessment.
  
  
Data analysis and problem investigation, using Excel or reporting tools to trace an issue back to its source rather than relying on assumption.
  
  
Familiarity with project delivery methods, both waterfall and Agile, and with formal change control and documentation discipline.
  
  
Working with Users and Stakeholders
  
  
Confident facilitating workshops with mixed groups, including users who are sceptical about system change.
  
  
Able to explain technical constraints in business terms and business priorities in technical terms, and to reach agreement without escalation.
  
  
Patient and credible when training or supporting users, with a genuine interest in how their work gets done.
  
  
Comfortable presenting recommendations, options and status updates to senior stakeholders and steering forums.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Degree in information systems, business, accounting, supply chain, engineering or a related discipline.
  
  
At least eight years of relevant IT or business analysis experience, including a minimum of three years working directly with SAP.
  
  
Professional certification such as CBAP, PMP or an SAP functional module certification is desirable but not essential.

The **Logistics Analyst** supports the end-to-end execution of air freight forwarding spot quotes. The role receives and reviews internal rate requests, determines whether contracted pricing is available and applicable, sources spot pricing when required, calculates the complete transportation cost, and coordinates with internal stakeholders and freight forwarders through quote selection and move execution. The analyst works across multiple procurement, sourcing, rate-management, reporting, and communication systems while maintaining accurate, timely, and audit-ready records.

**What You Will Do:**

* Manage assigned air freight rate requests from intake through closure, including Requests For Information (RFIs) and time-sensitive actual-move spot requests. Requests will be generated from internal and external sources.
* Review shipment details for completeness and accuracy, including origin and destination, requested service level, service type, commodity, dimensions, actual weight, chargeable weight, shipment date, special handling requirements, and required delivery timing.
* Research contracted rates, routing guides, rate validity dates, approved service levels, lane coverage, and allowable accessorial charges to determine whether an existing contract applies.
* Validate calculations and commercial terms against approved rate sources; identify missing, expired, conflicting, or non-applicable rates and escalate exceptions when needed.
* Create and maintain rate-request records across multiple systems, which may include Salesforce, RateCloud, Keelvar, Power BI, Excel, Teams, email, and other internal tools.
* Prepare and issue RFIs to support planning or cost-estimate decisions, clearly documenting assumptions and advising requestors that pricing may require revalidation before shipment execution.
* Launch actual-move spot requests to qualified air freight forwarders, communicate complete shipment requirements, establish response deadlines, monitor supplier responses, and follow up to meet shipment timing.
* Compare supplier offers for pricing, transit time, routing, capacity, service level, validity, exclusions, and operational feasibility; request clarification or revised offers when information is incomplete or inconsistent.
* Calculate the total expected move cost using the applicable chargeable weight, freight rate, minimum charges, fuel, security, pickup, delivery, handling, customs-related, special-service, and other approved accessorial charges. Normalize currencies and units of measure when required and document all assumptions.
* Provide requestors with a clear quote comparison and recommendation that identifies total cost, provider, routing, transit time, quote validity, assumptions, exclusions, and risks. Protect supplier pricing from unauthorized external disclosure.
* Collaborate with trade-lane teams, facilities, dealers, factories, procurement colleagues, operations teams, freight forwarders, and other internal and external partners to resolve questions and support timely spot-move execution.
* After a quote is selected, confirm award details with the appropriate parties; obtain and record the house air waybill or other booking reference; complete required approval documentation; and update the request through final closure.
* Maintain complete supporting documentation, including requests, quotes, calculations, approvals, correspondence, booking details, and exception rationale, in accordance with process, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Track open requests, priorities, response times, aging items, savings or cost avoidance, and exception trends; escalate urgent, high-risk, or stalled requests promptly.
* Follow export-control, confidentiality, procurement, sourcing, record-retention, and air freight forwarding requirements. Identify opportunities to improve templates, system data quality, turnaround time, and spot-quote reporting.

**What You Have:**

* Strong analytical ability and attention to detail, with demonstrated accuracy in rate validation, cost calculations, and data entry.
* Ability to manage multiple requests, systems, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while clearly prioritizing urgent actual moves.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filters, comparisons, and structured cost analysis; working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Ability to learn and navigate procurement, sourcing, rate-management, CRM, and reporting platforms.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to request missing information, summarize quote options, document assumptions, and coordinate with stakeholders across functions and regions.
* Working knowledge of air freight concepts such as chargeable weight, dimensional weight, service levels, origin/destination pairs, transit time, routing, quote validity, and accessorial charges preferred.
* Sound judgment in recognizing rate discrepancies, operational risks, incomplete data, and situations requiring escalation.

**Additional Info:**

* This position requires working onsite five days a week.
* Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Singapore which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).
* **This is on an agency contract for 12 months and will be on agency payroll.**

**What You Will Get:**

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

**Final Details:**

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.
